messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: Paging incident — Suspicious outbound auth traffic from staging-logship (svc-account=staging-shipper). High rate of POSTs to s3-external-bucket. Paging oncall-eng and secops.

maria: got it, i'm oncall-eng this shift. pulling logs now. any customer impact reported?

oncall-eng: I see a spike starting 09:12 UTC, ~4k requests/min from one instance group. We'll quarantine the instance group.

secops: confirm suspected data exfil? any sensitive keys in logs?

maria: initial grep shows truncated s3_put responses with 200s, filenames contain tenant IDs. sample: ```PUT /buckets/customer-assets/tenant_876/photo.jpg 200 - user=svc-staging-shipper key=AKIA...xYZ```

sam: whoa — that's a service account key snippet in the log. We need immediate key rotation for svc-staging-shipper and block egress to that external bucket.

oncall-eng: isolating cluster k8s-staging-3 now (cordon + drain non-critical pods). ETA 3m.

infra: adding WAF rule to drop outbound requests to s3-external-bucket from staging subnets. pushing ACL now.

secops: start rotating keys. Maria, can you create a scoped short-lived key to replace svc-staging-shipper for critical flows? Avoid full-service key until we confirm scope.

maria: creating scoped creds in IAM with immediate bind to staging pipeline, will expire in 6h. posting ARN in a sec.

legal: pls keep me in the loop. If customer data left our tenancy we may need to notify — what's the initial blast radius?

secops: preliminary: only artifacts written under "customer-assets/tenant_*" in staging. No prod buckets observed. We'll run a grep across log-archive and access logs to confirm timeframe and objects accessed.

sam: also enable audit logging on object GET/HEAD now, to track downstream retrievals.

maria: cluster isolated, ACL applied. new scoped key created: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-shipper-shortlived (rotated). Old key disabled.

secops: running extraction of outbound destinations. If we confirm data pushed to third-party bucket, we'll request object deletion through AWS support and capture evidence.

oncall-eng: i'm creating an incident bridge — https://meet.example.com/incident-2469998888 — join if needed.

legal: please collect timeline + list of tenants touched. We'll assess notification requirements.

maria: grep shows uploads from 09:12:04 — 09:17:20 UTC, ~90 unique tenant IDs, likely test accounts but treating as sensitive. saving sample logs to /tmp/incident-2469998888-evidence.log and uploading to secure-share.

secops: tagging incident as P1-security. Tasks: 1) confirm external uploads 2) request deletion 3) rotate remaining staging service keys 4) check for exfil from any prod roles 5) customer notification draft.

infra: WAF rule active. blocking rule id waf-8472. No additional egress observed since 09:18 UTC.

sam: good catch — enable temporary deny for all staging service roles to external S3 endpoints until rotation complete.

maria: running full account scan for other service keys, will rotate anything with write S3 scope. ETA 45m.

legal: if deletion request fails we'll need to file an injunction with provider; also prepare a short notice to affected customers — security-first wording, no blame.

secops: coordinating with provider support now (case #SR-987654). They acknowledged possible object removal; asked for evidence.zip. uploading evidence.

oncall-eng: folks — any chance this was an automated CI job misconfigured? Asking devs to check last deploys to staging pipelines.

maria: dev build 2026.03.15-rc2 pushed a new log-shipper config. I suspect a mis-escaped env var exposing raw auth header into logs. pushing hotfix to sanitize logger in PR 452.

sam: action items assigned in the bridge: rotate keys (secops + maria), ACL/WAF (infra), sanitize logs (maria + dev team), legal notification prep (legal), provider deletion request (secops). I'll update the incident board.

PagerBot: Incident updated: status=mitigated (egress blocked, keys rotated), severity=P1-security, bridge=active.

maria: wrapping up — continuing scans for any other suspicious traffic, will post final timeline and RCA draft in #postmortems when bridge closes.

legal: thanks. keep evidence preserved and chain-of-custody notes.

secops: closing immediate pager. monitoring for 24h. reopen if any new egress. :white_check_mark:
